title: EventEmailSettingsMmoOutcomeFilterRequest
description: Request body for PUT /organizations/{organizationId}/event-email-settings/{context}/mmo-outcome-filter. context is specified in the URL path, not in this body. Sets which primary MMO (Managed Medical Outcomes) plan outcomes trigger event emails for the context; if both approved and denied plan UDF outcomes are present for the same workflow event, both emails are still sent regardless of this filter.

mmoOutcomeFilter.description: Primary outcome(s) to allow: "Positive" (approved plan outcomes) and/or "Negative" (denied plan outcomes). Any other value is rejected with 400. Null or empty array clears the filter (both outcome types allowed).
